channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Quaest: 31% dos eleitores priorizam candidatos ao Senado com foco em emendas e obras para o estado
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows that 31% of voters prioritize candidates for the Senate who focus on bringing amendments and public works to their state in the 2026 elections. Next, 15% favor candidates endorsed by President Lula, 13% prioritize ending the 6x1 work schedule, 12% value independence from political polarization, and 11% support impeaching STF ministers. Bolsonaro’s endorsement attracts 8%, while 10% were unsure or gave no response. The survey interviewed 2,004 people aged 16+ from July 31 to August 3, with a 2-point margin of error at 95% confidence.

item.title: Caiado cita deputado Pedro Paulo e Ana Carla Abrão entre opções para a área administrativa
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD candidate for President of Brazil, mentioned Deputy Pedro Paulo (PSD) and Ana Carla Abrão as possible names for the administrative area of his government plan. The statement was made during the Diálogos CEO One event, promoted by VIP Battistini, a corporate networking ecosystem. Caiado emphasized the importance of selecting qualified professionals for public management.

item.title: Renan Santos desafia Flávio Bolsonaro e propõe acordo na campanha
item.description: Renan Santos challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to participate in electoral debates and criticized the PL candidate's lack of policy proposals, suggesting an agreement to prevent the leakage of compromising videos involving Bolsonaro. He emphasized the opponent's unserious campaign and reinforced his own commitment to transparency.

item.title: Republicanos neutro, Motta com Lula na Paraíba
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies and member of the Republicans party from Paraíba, declared his support for President Lula's re-election in Paraíba, despite the national party's neutrality. His stance reflects a local alliance between the Republicans and the PT in the state, diverging from the party's national directive.

item.title: Crusoé: O problema de ACM Neto com o bolsonarismo
item.description: ACM Neto, the União Brasil candidate for governor of Bahia, avoids associating with Bolsonarism and affirms his support for Ronaldo Caiado's presidential pre-candidacy. He seeks to distance himself from former President Jair Bolsonaro while maintaining a political stance aligned with center-right figures. The content highlights Neto's challenge in balancing right-wing support without directly aligning with Bolsonarism.

item.title: Silveira vê ‘maioria’ do PSD com Lula no 2º turno e diz que presidente é fonte de estabilidade
item.description: Minister Alexandre Silveira (PSD) states that the majority of his party will support Lula in a potential second-round runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro, citing PSD mayors who already back Lula in the first round. He views Lula as a source of institutional stability and warns that a Flávio Bolsonaro victory could bring institutional instability, particularly amid current global tensions.

item.title: Em encontro com empresários, Caiado chama Lula e Flávio de covardes
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) harshly criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) during a meeting with business leaders in São Paulo, calling them "cowards" and accusing them of "moral cowardice" for avoiding electoral debates. He also advocated for public security proposals, including reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 16 for specific crimes and classifying criminal factions as domestic terrorist organizations, while naming prosecutor Lincoln Gakiya as a potential future Minister of Public Security.

item.title: Vice de Flávio: Câmara envia depoimento de ‘homem-bomba’ ao STF
item.description: The presidency of the Chamber of Deputies has sent the full testimony of merchant Luiz Antonio Lopes, known as the 'human bomb', to the Supreme Federal Court (STF). Lopes alleged a plot to fabricate a rape accusation against deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL), who is the running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 election. He claimed he was coerced into participating in the scheme. The case is politically significant as it involves the Bolsonaro ticket in an alleged disinformation and defamation operation ahead of the elections.

item.title: Debate da Band entre Tarcísio e Haddad perde para João Kleber
item.description: The Band debate between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad recorded low viewership in Greater São Paulo, with only 1.5 rating points and a peak of 2 points, falling even below João Kleber's show. The result suggests public disengagement or low perceived relevance of the electoral debate.

item.title: Motta registra candidatura e declara R$ 1,3 milhão em bens
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, filed his candidacy for the 2026 elections and declared R$ 1.26 million in assets to the TSE, representing an 8.1% increase from 2022. Declared assets include R$ 250,000 in cash, a 50% stake in an aircraft (R$ 100,000), capital quotas (R$ 100,000), properties in Brasília, João Pessoa, and Patos, a vehicle, and bank balances. The asset disclosure is a mandatory part of candidate registration and is publicly accessible via the TSE.

item.title: Hugo Motta declara apoio à reeleição de Lula: 'O melhor para o país'
item.description: Hugo Motta, President of the Chamber of Deputies, announced that the Republican Party's Paraíba state directory will support Lula's re-election in 2026, following the party's national leadership decision to remain neutral and allow state directories to choose their own candidates. The statement was made during the swearing-in of Judge Giovanna Mayer at the TRE-PB, with Motta stating the support is based on alignment with what he believes is best for the country. The move also reflects Motta's political strategy to back his father, Nabor Wanderley, for Senate in 2026, strengthening an alliance with the federal government.

item.title: O que dizem as últimas pesquisas para presidente nas Eleições 2026
item.description: Four recent polls show Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) as the leading candidates in the 2026 Brazilian presidential race, with varying percentages depending on the pollster and runoff scenario. Lula holds a slight edge in some surveys, while Bolsonaro leads in others, indicating a highly competitive and polarized contest. The results suggest the runoff will likely be decided between these two figures, with no other candidates currently demonstrating significant relevance.

item.title: O que o ministro do Planejamento espera de um quarto mandato de Lula
item.description: Planning Minister Bruno Moretti states that a potential fourth term for President Lula must prioritize the structural reduction of interest rates as essential for a lasting economic legacy. He argues that improving the investment environment depends on lowering the cost of money, with the fiscal framework serving as a mechanism to enforce spending rationalization and stimulate efficiency in public resource allocation.

item.title: Caiado chama Lula e Flávio de ‘fujões’ e diz que possível ausência em debates seria ‘covardia moral’
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for potentially avoiding electoral debates, calling them 'cowards' and accusing them of 'moral cowardice'. He cited high rejection rates for both candidates (50% and 48% per BTG/Nexus poll) as evidence of voter dissatisfaction and pledged to attend all debates. Caiado also criticized Lula over rare earth mining in Goiás, promised to cut interest rates by half in six months through governmental credibility, and advocated for fiscal reforms without specifying details.

item.title: Tarcísio almoça com prefeitos da Grande SP e acertam mobilização para campanha
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) met with mayors from 38 of the 39 municipalities in the Greater São Paulo region during a lunch meeting on Monday to discuss campaign mobilization. The only absentee was Marcelo Oliveira, the Workers' Party mayor of Mauá. The meeting took place on August 10, 2026, at 3:19 PM.

item.title: Presidente da Câmara, Hugo Motta declara apoio à reeleição de Lula
item.description: Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB), President of the Chamber of Deputies, declared his support for the reelection of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the 2026 elections, after waiting for the national party's stance. Although the national directory of the Republicanos party chose neutrality, the Paraíba state wing, aligned with Lula, has declared support for the president, with the state ticket featuring Lucas Ribeiro (PP) for governor and Nabor Wanderley, Motta's father, for Senate.

item.title: TRE de Roraima autoriza ex-governador afastado após cassação a disputar vaga no Senado em 2026
item.description: The TRE-RR recognized the eligibility of former Governor Edilson Damião (União) to run for Senate in 2026, following his compulsory removal from office by the TSE due to the annulment of the 2022 elected ticket. The court determined that the constitutional incompatibility deadline ended while he was still lawfully in office and that his prior removal eliminated the risk of administrative misuse, fulfilling the purpose of the incompatibility rule.

item.title: Flávio se inspira em carta de Bolsonaro para criar marca de campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro used a letter written by his father, Jair Bolsonaro, in December 2025, as inspiration for his 2026 presidential campaign branding. The central symbol is a stylized 'V' in green and yellow, referencing the Brazilian flag and the slogan 'Brazil will win'. The marketing, led by Duda Lima, emphasizes the name 'Flávio' and downplays the surname 'Bolsonaro' in campaign materials.

item.title: Lindbergh e Soraya silenciam diante de denúncia de suposta armação contra Gaspar
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) and Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS), who initially accused Alfredo Gaspar of misconduct, have remained silent following a police report suggesting a plot to fabricate a rape of a minor allegation against the lawmaker, who is now the running mate of Flávio Bolsonaro. O Antagonista sought comments but received no response from the politicians. The case raises suspicions of a possible political setup.

item.title: Caiado afirma que o 'divisor de águas dessa eleição é a moral'
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that the defining issue of the 2026 election is morality, speaking at the Diálogos CEO One event hosted by VIP Battistini. He emphasized ethics and integrity as central criteria for voters in choosing the next president.

item.title: Governo Lula libera R$ 65 mi em emendas de Soraya após denúncia sobre vice de Flávio
item.description: The Lula government allocated R$ 65.29 million in parliamentary amendments to Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) after she, together with Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ), reported Deputy Alfredo Gaspar (PL-AL) to the Federal Police for alleged rape of a vulnerable person and attempted concealment of facts. The amount represents 96.31% of the senator’s total amendments.

item.title: Lula oferece assistência à Colômbia após terremoto que derrubou mais de 30 edifícios
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva offered humanitarian assistance to Colombia following a 7.4-magnitude earthquake that killed over 70 people and collapsed more than 30 buildings, with the epicenter in Chocó department. The disaster impacted cities including Bogotá, Cali, Pereira and Manizales, causing structural collapses, injuries and heightened alert due to aftershocks.

item.title: A reação de Lula ao forte terremoto de magnitude 7,4 na Colômbia
item.description: President Lula expressed concern over the 7.4-magnitude earthquake that struck Colombia on Monday, August 10, 2026, with its epicenter in the Chocó department. Via social media platform X, he conveyed solidarity with the Colombian people, particularly victims’ families, and offered Brazilian forces to assist local authorities in relief efforts. Preliminary reports indicate at least 70 deaths from structural collapses, and the tremor was also felt in Ecuador and Panama.

item.title: Brasileirão: Chapecoense ultrapassa 98% de chance de rebaixamento
item.description: Chapecoense has a 98.6% probability of relegation in the 2026 Brasileirão, sitting last with 10 points after matchday 22. Remo (52.6%), Vasco (48.3%) and Santos (41.9%) follow in the relegation zone with 22 points each, while Internacional (40.9%), Grêmio (40.7%) and Mirassol (25.6%) also face significant relegation risk.

item.title: Flávio diz a Cleitinho que queria apoiá-lo, mas descarta palanque duplo e diz que aliança só ocorrerá no 2º turno
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro told Cleitinho he would like to support him in the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race, but that the PL will keep Flávio Roscoe as its candidate to avoid lacking a presidential ally in the state. Both agreed they would support each other in a runoff if only one advances. Cleitinho was reinstated as the Republican candidate after publicly pressing the party, citing a divine inspiration, following his earlier withdrawal.

item.title: Michelle deve gravar para horário eleitoral de Flávio nesta semana e começa campanha no DF com agendas fechadas
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro will begin recording for Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral broadcast this week and launch her Senate campaign in the Federal District with closed agendas, prioritizing reserved meetings. Although still absent from public events, her participation in the presidential propaganda is already confirmed, with expectations of joint appearances in the material. Allies are trying to persuade her to attend Flávio's campaign launch event in Rio de Janeiro on the 16th, but her presence depends on caring for Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula expressa “preocupação” com terremoto na Colômbia
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed concern over a 7.4-magnitude earthquake that struck Colombia, causing over 70 deaths and widespread destruction, particularly in San José del Palmar, Chocó. Speaking on behalf of the Brazilian people, Lula conveyed solidarity with the victims and reaffirmed Brazil’s readiness to provide humanitarian assistance, recalling its earlier support for Venezuela following similar seismic events in June.

item.title: Lula diz que o Brasil está à disposição para ajudar a Colômbia após terremoto
item.description: President Lula expressed solidarity with Colombia after a 7.4-magnitude earthquake killed 80 people and caused widespread damage, stating Brazil is ready to assist. The Itamaraty confirmed no Brazilian nationals were among the victims and reiterated Brazil’s humanitarian support. Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella declared a national disaster and is leading rescue efforts in affected areas such as Cali and Pereira.

item.title: Tarcísio x Haddad: quem errou ou distorceu mais dados no debate da Band
item.description: During the Band debate, Governor Tarcísio de Freitas made incorrect claims about São Paulo's public education performance in the Ideb, asserting improvements that did not occur, while Fernando Haddad's statements were not fact-checked in the provided excerpt. Agência Lupa rated Tarcísio's claims as false or lacking context, particularly regarding the evolution of basic and secondary education in the state.

item.title: Câmara pode votar medidas provisórias e projetos ligados ao agronegócio nesta semana
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies will hold a concentrated voting effort this week (August 10–14) to approve provisional measures and projects linked to agribusiness and the productive sector before the intense electoral period begins. Among the proposals are seven MPs that expire if not approved by the end of August, including MP 1355/26 (New Desenrola Brazil) for family debt renegotiation and MP 1349/26 for financial aid to diesel and cooking gas importers, plus fuel subsidy projects. Controversial topics are expected to be postponed until after the elections, according to the Legislative Consultancy.

item.title: Caiado quer Gakiya para ministério, mas promotor diz que não pode aceitar
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced he intends to appoint Lincoln Gakiya, a prosecutor from São Paulo's Gaeco (Special Action Group to Combat Organized Crime), as Minister of Public Security if elected. Gakiya, however, stated he cannot accept the offer due to ethical and functional restrictions within the Public Prosecutor's Office.

item.title: Flávio trava presença em debate à espera de Lula, diz diretor da Band
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has not yet confirmed his participation in the Band presidential debate and is waiting for President Lula’s (PT) decision before committing, according to Band’s journalism director Rodolfo Schneider. This wait-and-see approach reflects a common political tactic where allies defer to the leader’s move.

item.title: Lula lamenta terremoto na Colômbia e manifesta solidariedade às famílias das vítimas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva expressed sorrow over the 7.4-magnitude earthquake that struck Colombia on Monday (10) and extended solidarity to the victims' families, stating Brazil is ready to provide necessary support. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Itamaraty) issued a similar statement, confirming no Brazilians were among the victims and offering cooperation in emergency response efforts. The quake caused 69 deaths and significant damage, including the collapse of 20 buildings in Cali.

item.title: TSE avalia ampliar proibição de deepfake na campanha eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is evaluating a definitive ban on the use of deepfake in electoral campaigns to avoid excessive judicialization and establish precedent for Regional Electoral Courts. The discussion stems from a PT lawsuit against an AI-generated video of former President Jair Bolsonaro shown at the PL convention, with the defense arguing the AI label prevented deception. While March resolutions already prohibit deepfake to benefit or harm candidacies, the TSE is considering expanding the ban to include minor image and voice alterations.

item.title: Intensificação de agressões a Lula imporá ao Brasil o desafio de separar a política externa da disputa eleitoral, diz professor
item.description: The attacks by Javier Milei against Lula and the post by U.S. Representative Carlos Gimenez replacing Nicolás Maduro's face with Lula's alongside a cachaça bottle reflect a trend where social media image and messaging are outweighing actual foreign policy execution, according to Professor Carlos Frederico de Souza Coelho. This poses Brazil with the challenge of separating foreign policy from electoral disputes in 2026.

item.title: Alta de imposto, gasto e dívida pública estão entre últimas preocupações dos brasileiros, mostra BTG/Nexus
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll shows that, despite economists' warnings about Brazil's fiscal situation, taxes, public spending, and public debt are not among voters' top concerns. Tax increases rank 10th with 7% of responses, followed by public spending (11th, 4%) and public debt (13th, 2%). The top concerns are security, health, corruption, and education.

item.title: Haddad imaginário domina Tarcísio em debate
item.description: The content satirizes the recurring narrative in Brazilian electoral campaigns, in which Fernando Haddad is portrayed as a reluctant candidate, despite the PT militants' strenuous effort to propel him forward. The author suggests this pattern repeated in a recent debate against Tarcísio de Freitas, depicting Haddad as an 'imaginary' candidate who only appears dominant due to partisan staging.

item.title: Caiado diz que convidará Lincoln Gakiya para Ministério da Segurança
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced that, if elected president in 2026, he will invite prosecutor Lincoln Gakiya from Gaeco to lead a new Ministry of Public Security, separate from the Ministry of Justice, modeled after the 2018 structure under Michel Temer. Caiado praised Gakiya for his work against the PCC, including the request to transfer PCC leader Marcola to a federal prison, describing him as determined and resilient amid years of police protection due to criminal threats. The announcement, made in São Paulo during the presentation of Caiado’s security plan, underscores public safety as a top electoral issue, with 66.8% of Brazilians citing crime and drug trafficking as the nation’s main problems.

item.title: Grupo que planejava atentado em Brasília nas eleições tinha mapa das plantas do Congresso e do STF
item.description: An apartisan group was dismantled by the Federal District Civil Police for planning terrorist attacks during the 2026 elections in Brasília. The suspects possessed maps of Congress, the STF, and ministries, discussed blowing up buildings where second-round debates would occur, and used Telegram to spread neo-Nazi, antisemitic, and misogynistic ideologies, along with explosives manuals.

item.title: Após ter mandato cassado, ex-governador de Roraima é liberado pelo TRE para disputar o Senado
item.description: Former Roraima governor Edilson Damião was authorized by the TRE-RR to run for the Senate, despite having his mandate cassated by the TSE. The decision created an exception to the six-month resignation rule, as Damião remained in office after the deadline due to a judicial order, not by his own choice. He had assumed office on March 27 after Antonio Denarium resigned to run for the Senate, and his mandate was cassated on April 28 for political and economic abuse of power.

item.title: Sargento Gonçalves cobra TSE por voto de PMs em serviço
item.description: Federal Deputy Sargento Gonçalves (PL-RN) filed a request with the TSE and other authorities to ensure military police officers on duty can vote in the 2026 elections. The measure aims to address logistical barriers preventing PMs from voting while on duty.

item.title: Debate com Tarcísio mostrou ponto fraco de Haddad na eleição de São Paulo, diz cientista político
item.description: The first debate between Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad in the São Paulo gubernatorial race was described by political scientist Elias Tavares as a qualified but low-energy encounter that foreshadowed a potential 2030 presidential showdown. Haddad sought to nationalize the race by frequently referencing Jair Bolsonaro, while Tarcísio emphasized defending his state administration. With no significant third-party contenders, the first round effectively functioned as a premature runoff.

item.title: Prêmio Innovare bate recorde de inscrições com foco na gestão do Judiciário
item.description: The Innovare Award 2026 reached a record with 807 submitted practices focused on improving the management of the Brazilian Judiciary. The judging committee, including representatives from the Brazilian Magistrates Association (AMB), began evaluations at the STJ, with analysis expected to conclude by September 28 across seven categories covering judicial activities and citizenship. The awards ceremony will be held on December 3 at the STF headquarters, also featuring the Distinction Award for the entry best meeting all evaluation criteria.

item.title: Taxa das blusinhas pode voltar em um mês se Lula não conseguir a aprovação do Congresso
item.description: The Lula government needs Congress to approve by September 8 the MP 1.357/26, which repeals the 'blusinhas tax' on imports under US$ 50. If not approved, the measure expires and the 20% import tariff returns immediately, remaining in place until a new law revokes it. The exemption is popular with over 70% public support, but creates tension between e-commerce platforms and domestic industry.

item.title: Fazer campanha para convertidos não fará de ninguém um vencedor
item.description: Polling stability in the 2026 Brazilian presidential race shows Lula with a slight edge over Flávio Bolsonaro, yet both camps fail to win over undecided voters, stuck in alienation rather than persuasion. Flávio’s allies, like his brother Carlos, attack even the 'permitted' center-right, while Lula retreats from proposals like renationalization and zero tariffs to improve his fiscal image. Raising past controversies over vaccines and censorship only deepens polarization without gaining new support.

item.title: Esforço concentrado no Senado dependerá de nova reunião entre Lula e Alcolumbre; governo vê dificuldade para aprovar pautas
item.description: The approval of the government's priority agendas in the Senate depends on a new meeting between Lula and Alcolumbre, as the first encounter was seen only as an initial step in their rapprochement. While relations with the Chamber are favorable, there is pessimism in the Senate about voting in August on key proposals such as the PEC to end the 6x1 work scale and the Public Security PEC. The government is also monitoring two Chamber initiatives: the MP that abolished the 'tax on small packages' and the project using extra oil revenue to curb fuel price increases, though business groups are mobilizing to invalidate the MP before its September deadline.

item.title: Caiado diz que irá convidar Lincoln Gakiya para Ministério da Segurança
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado announced he will invite São Paulo prosecutor Lincoln Gakiya to lead a proposed Ministry of Security if elected. Gakiya, a leading figure in Brazil's fight against the PCC criminal faction, orchestrated the 2019 transfer of gang leaders to federal prisons and has faced multiple assassination attempts. Caiado praised Gakiya's 'determined' and 'resilient' approach to combating organized crime.

item.title: Ao menos 27 de 33 candidatos do PL ao Senado defendem impeachment de Moraes
item.description: At least 27 of the 33 PL Senate candidates support the impeachment of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, according to a Estadão survey. The issue is seen as an electoral asset by Bolsonaristas, with candidates like Flávio Bolsonaro, André do Prado, and Carlos Portinho taking hardline stances against the judiciary, while others, such as Marcelo Queiroga, avoid direct statements.

item.title: Caiado sugere medidas contra ‘terrorismo doméstico’ e quer Lincoln Gakiya em ministério
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a presidential candidate in 2026, proposed the creation of a 'domestic terrorism' offense and a new Ministry of Public Security, nominating São Paulo prosecutor Lincoln Gakiya to lead it. His plan includes stricter penalties, integrated security operations, a proposed 'Sulpol' agency modeled after Europol, and prison reforms to isolate faction leaders. Caiado also addressed gender-based violence, warning that prisons without total isolation become command centers for criminal organizations.

item.title: Polícia investiga grupo que planejava ataques em Brasília durante as eleições
item.description: The Federal District Civil Police is investigating a group that planned attacks in Brasília during the 2026 elections, including building invasions, target selection, tactical training, and recruitment across multiple states. Operation Rede Interrompida led to the arrest of eight individuals aged 19 to 31, located in Santa Catarina, Paraná, São Paulo, Pernambuco, and Rio Grande do Sul, with support from state civil police forces. The investigation, triggered by a Ciberlab report, includes seized electronic devices, maps, 3D building models, and manuals for manufacturing explosive devices.
